# sonrai_organization_policy_attachment (Resource)

Attaches an organization policy to an account, organizational unit or the root of an AWS organization. The policy then applies there and to everything beneath, including accounts added later.

Attaching and detaching are staged. Neither is in force until the root scope is submitted and deployed, so reference `revision` in the `triggers` of its `sonrai_control_submission`.

A policy that already reaches the target is rejected rather than adopted; import the attachment instead.

~> **A scope the policy reaches from above looks attached.** The platform records the policy at every scope beneath an attachment and does not say which one it was attached at. An attachment to an account whose organizational unit is also attached therefore cannot be told apart from inheritance: it reads as present for as long as the unit's does, and the platform refuses to detach it while the unit's remains unless it was attached there directly. Attach at one level of a branch, not several.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach at one level of a branch. The policy applies at the target and
# everything beneath it, including accounts added later.
resource "sonrai_organization_policy_attachment" "workloads" {
  policy_id   = sonrai_organization_policy.deny_leaving_org.id
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "ou-abcd-1a2b3c4d"
}

# One account elsewhere in the organization.
resource "sonrai_organization_policy_attachment" "sandbox" {
  policy_id   = sonrai_organization_policy.deny_leaving_org.id
  root_scope  = "aws/r-abcd"
  resource_id = "123456789012"
}

# Attaching and detaching are staged. Both take effect when submitted.
resource "sonrai_control_submission" "firewall" {
  root_scope = "aws/r-abcd"

  triggers = {
    workloads = sonrai_organization_policy_attachment.workloads.revision
    sandbox   = sonrai_organization_policy_attachment.sandbox.revision
    policy    = sonrai_organization_policy.deny_leaving_org.revision
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_id` (String) The `id` of the `sonrai_organization_policy` to attach. Forces replacement.
- `resource_id` (String) AWS id of what to attach the policy to: an account such as `123456789012`, an organizational unit such as `ou-ab12-cdef3456`, or the root itself, such as `r-abcd`. Forces replacement.
- `root_scope` (String) Root scope of the AWS organization, for example `aws/r-abcd`. Forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the form `policy_id@root_scope@resource_id`.
- `revision` (String) Opaque value that changes every time this resource stages a change. Reference it in the `triggers` of the `sonrai_control_submission` for its root scope, so that anything this resource stages is submitted, including a plan that only reverts a change made outside Terraform.
- `scope` (String) Scope path `resource_id` resolved to, recomputed on every read.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Import ID: policy_id@root_scope@resource_id.
import {
  to = sonrai_organization_policy_attachment.workloads
  id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000000@aws/r-abcd@ou-abcd-1a2b3c4d"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID: policy_id@root_scope@resource_id.
terraform import sonrai_organization_policy_attachment.workloads 'a1b2c3d4-0000-4000-8000-000000000000@aws/r-abcd@ou-abcd-1a2b3c4d'
```
